The '''Duro sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Its capital planet was [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] itself. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] redrew sectorial boundaries, making the Duro sector part of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] and thus depriving the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] of direct Senatorial representation. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] reestablished the original boundaries. [[Jenssar SoBilles]] represented Duro sector on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]].
